summary: Completed testing of University Knowledge Base feature. All 15 backend tests passed and all frontend features verified working correctly. The knowledge base contains 1,053 universities imported from Excel files (D1: 347, D2: 284, D3: 422). Filter dropdowns (Division, Region, Conference), search by college name, pagination (50 per page, 22 pages), Add to Board functionality, and coach info display all work correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/knowledge-base returns 1053 universities total
GET /api/knowledge-base?division=D1 returns 347 universities
GET /api/knowledge-base?division=D2 returns 284 universities
GET /api/knowledge-base?division=D3 returns 422 universities
GET /api/knowledge-base?search=Stanford returns 1 result (Stanford University)
GET /api/knowledge-base?region=Midwest returns 198 filtered results
GET /api/knowledge-base?conference=Big%20Ten returns 18 conference-filtered results
GET /api/knowledge-base/filters returns 107 conferences and 10 regions
POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board adds university with coach data
POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board returns 400 for missing university_name
POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board returns 404 for non-existent university
GET /api/suggested-schools returns suggestions based on profile
Combined filters (division+region, division+conference) work correctly
University data structure includes expected fields
Frontend /knowledge-base page loads and shows '1053 colleges found'
Frontend Division filter dropdown works (D1=347, D2=284, D3=422)
Frontend Region filter dropdown works (Midwest=198)
Frontend Conference filter dropdown works (Big Ten=18)
Frontend search by college name works (Stanford search)
Frontend pagination displays 50 per page, 22 total pages
Frontend pagination Prev/Next buttons work correctly
Frontend university cards display coach name when available
Frontend 'Add to Board' button works (Yale University added successfully)
Frontend 'Recommended for You' section displays 12 matches with match scores
critical_code_review_comments: Knowledge base API well-implemented with proper filtering (division, region, conference, search)
Pagination correctly implemented at 50 per page
Add-to-board transfers coach data (primary_coach, coach_email, recruiting_coordinator, coordinator_email)
Filter endpoint returns sorted distinct values for conferences (107) and regions (10)
Frontend uses proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Used existing 1,053 universities imported from Excel files. Added Yale University to board during testing.
